title: Numbers With Same Consecutive Differences
description: Return all non-negative integers of length n such that every two consecutive digits have an absolute difference of k.
pseudocode:
1. result = []
2. for digit from 1 to 9:
3.   dfs(digit, 1, result, n, k)
4. 
5. dfs(num, length, result, n, k):
6.   if length == n: result.push(num); return
7.   lastDigit = num % 10
8.   for nextDigit in [lastDigit - k, lastDigit + k]:
9.     if 0 <= nextDigit <= 9:
10.      dfs(num * 10 + nextDigit, length + 1, result, n, k)

steps.note: Calculating next digits for lastDigit 1 with k=1: 0 and 2
